summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia filed a Form 6-K reporting a Notice of Material Event regarding the declaration of a cash dividend. The Board of Directors, authorized by the Ordinary Shareholders Meeting on April 28, 2026, made available a cash dividend of Ps. 150,000,228,000 to shareholders of record as of May 5, 2026, payable starting May 8, 2026. This is a routine capital return event with no M&A, activist, or structural change elements. As a foreign private issuer 6-K, it is the equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K for material corporate events, but a standard dividend declaration does not constitute a special situation.
